runs.text: Place each kiosk job in the piece that has the information to do it.
Each job goes to the piece that has the data it needs: the price is in the product, the stock in the inventory, what was sold in the till and the lines in the receipt.
Knowing the price of a product.
Computing the amount of a quantity.
Knowing how much is left of each product.
Taking away from the stock if there is enough.
Noting a line of the receipt.
